title: Agentic Spatio-Temporal Grounding via Collaborative Reasoning

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to retrieve the spatio-temporal tube of a target object or person in a video given a text query.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) is to locate a target object both spatially and temporally according to a query text which usually contains static visual cues and dynamic action cues.

evidence.quote: # Introduction Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) is to locate a target object both spatially and temporally according to a query text which usually contains static visual cues and dynamic action cues.
